turns.content: In a short research note on halophytes, explain why constitutively elevated activity of stress-responsive genes can be adaptive in saline habitats.
Extend the note with a biochemical example: identify the proteinogenic imino acid used as a compatible solute and explain its role under osmotic stress.
In the same transcriptomic context, would salt-associated changes in mRNA alternative polyadenylation be biologically plausible? Explain briefly.

A draft note also lists 'limiting net photosynthesis in photosystem III and limiting gas exchange' as a halophyte adaptation. Analyze that wording by separating the physiological response from the named photosystem.
Which element of the draft note is biologically invalid, and which part still describes a plausible salt-stress response?
Explain the basis for that classification and assess the physiological plausibility of the remaining response under stress.
Give the resulting conclusion in one sentence.
